concept: When something goes wrong, you can usually do something about it, even a small thing
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character faces a problem and, instead of just feeling stuck, finds one small thing they can actually do about it
exercise.reflection_prompt: What small thing did the character find they could do, even though they couldn't fix everything?
exercise.practice: Student names a problem they're facing and one small thing within their control

assessment.success_marker: student names a real, small, actionable thing within their control
